name: bristle-14-userseeds-roundtrip
description: BUG 0003 REGRESSION: a UserSeeds click must come back where it was clicked. The click goes in as canvas mm via analysis.seeds.points_mm, the engine places it with placement.fit, and BR_Regions hands it back through the SAME placement - so this fails if either direction drifts. The point is asymmetric in both axes on purpose: x=15mm sits near the left edge where the letterbox error is maximal (at the centre the old and new maths agree to 0.01mm), and y=90mm is off the vertical centre so a y-flip cannot hide. Under the old whole-canvas maths the seed returned ~8.25mm away. This is the ONLY automated coverage of click-to-prompt - no other definition wires BR_Submit input 11.

checkpoints.name: userseeds-roundtrip
checkpoints.description: Top view: the seed dot should sit on the click, near the left edge

asserts.description: every native component resolved and wired

777 = at least one returned seed is within 0.6 mm of the click. The token is 777 rather than 1 because a panel rendering a TREE prints branch headers like {0;1} - asserting on '1' would pass on the header and prove nothing.
the seed came back tagged as a USER seed, not an auto one - so RoundTrip cannot be satisfied by an auto seed that happens to be near
the engine accepted points_mm - a 422 here means the engine predates the bug 0003 fix
